"""Capture complete authorized typed-port checks on this existing CAS lane."""

import hashlib
import json
import os
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = pathlib.Path("/workspace/e02-B-current-cas-generation")
PRODUCT = ROOT / "policy-engine"
RAW = ROOT / ".polisyos/e02-B-current/raw/cas-typed-ports"
PYTHON = pathlib.Path("/workspace/e02-B-current-coordination/.polisyos/e02-B-current/environment/bin/python")
CAPS = ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS", "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS", "VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS", "BLIS_NUM_THREADS")
SOURCES = ["src/polisyos/core/artifacts/_integrity_ops.py", "src/polisyos/core/artifacts/store.py", "src/polisyos/core/artifacts/_transfer_ops.py"]
TESTS = [
    "tests/unit/core/artifacts/test_put_integrity_retry.py",
    "tests/unit/core/artifacts/test_import_admission_noop.py",
    "tests/unit/core/artifacts/test_transfer_generation_publication.py",
    "tests/unit/core/artifacts/test_verification_failure_snapshot_report.py",
    "tests/unit/core/artifacts/test_cas_integrity_report.py",
    "tests/unit/core/artifacts/test_artifact_store_protocol.py",
    "tests/unit/core/artifacts/test_multi_tenant_shared_cas.py",
]


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(ROOT), *args], text=True).strip()


tag = sys.argv[1]
if tag.endswith("mypy"):
    argv = [str(PYTHON), "-m", "mypy", *SOURCES[:2]]
elif tag == "ruff":
    argv = [str(PYTHON), "-m", "ruff", "check", "--no-cache", *SOURCES[1:]]
elif tag == "format":
    argv = [str(PYTHON), "-m", "ruff", "format", "--check", *SOURCES[1:]]
elif tag == "native":
    argv = [str(PYTHON), "-m", "pytest", "-vv", *TESTS, "--basetemp", str(RAW / "native-pytest"), "-o", "cache_dir=" + str(RAW / "native-cache"), "--junitxml=" + str(RAW / "native.xml")]
else:
    raise ValueError(tag)
env = dict(os.environ)
removed = [key for key in CAPS if key in env]
for key in CAPS:
    env.pop(key, None)
env.update(PYTHONPATH=str(PRODUCT / "src") + ":" + str(PRODUCT), UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=str(PYTHON.parent.parent), UV_NO_SYNC="1", POLISYOS_METRICS_PORT="0")
assert env.get("E02_B_PROPERTY_REMOVAL") is None
head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
tree = git("rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}")
status = git("status", "--porcelain")
assert git("symbolic-ref", "--short", "HEAD") == "codex/e02-B-current-cas-generation"
inputs = []
for rel in [*SOURCES, *TESTS, "pyproject.toml", "pytest.ini", "uv.lock"]:
    data = (PRODUCT / rel).read_bytes()
    inputs.append({"path": "policy-engine/" + rel, "bytes": len(data), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), "git_blob": git("rev-parse", head + ":policy-engine/" + rel)})
stdout = RAW / (tag + ".txt")
record = RAW / (tag + ".json")
assert not stdout.exists() and not record.exists()
started = time.monotonic()
descriptor = os.open(stdout, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o644)
pid = os.fork()
if pid == 0:
    os.dup2(descriptor, 1)
    os.dup2(descriptor, 2)
    os.close(descriptor)
    os.chdir(PRODUCT)
    os.execvpe(argv[0], argv, env)
os.close(descriptor)
_, wait_status, usage = os.wait4(pid, 0)
exit_code = os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(wait_status)
assert git("rev-parse", "HEAD") == head
data = stdout.read_bytes()
payload = {"command_argv": argv, "cwd": str(PRODUCT), "actual_head_before": head, "actual_tree_before": tree, "actual_head_after": git("rev-parse", "HEAD"), "status_before": status, "status_after": git("status", "--porcelain"), "source_and_native_input_identity": inputs, "environment": {k: env.get(k) for k in ["PYTHONPATH", "UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT", "UV_NO_SYNC", "POLISYOS_METRICS_PORT", "E02_B_PROPERTY_REMOVAL"]}, "ambient_cap_names_removed": removed, "all_numeric_caps_absent": list(CAPS), "exit_code": exit_code, "wall_s": time.monotonic() - started, "exact_child_rusage_maxrss_kib": usage.ru_maxrss, "output_path": str(stdout), "output_bytes": len(data), "output_sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), "qualification": "Full explicit static/native inputs, not a universal transitive import/resource/backend read-set. Dirty status, if present, is an overlay and not a frozen HEAD run."}
record.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(payload, indent=2))
raise SystemExit(exit_code)
qualification: Literal executed driver bytes. No pytest/source imported by the wrapper before exact execvpe; child argv/cwd/env/output/wait4 are retained per check. Intermediate overlays are not frozen HEAD executions.
